newsitem.title: GERMANY: Franco-German talks put off due to French election.
newsitem.headline: Franco-German talks put off due to French election.

text.p: Talks planned for next Monday between German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel and his French counterpart Herve de Charette have been put off because of next month's French election, Kinkel's ministry said on Thursday.
Instead of meeting de Charette in Hamburg, Kinkel will now hold talks with Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo, whose country holds the six-month rotating European Union presidency.
The discussions will focus on preparations for the EU's institutional reform summit, to be held in Amsterdam in June.

French President Jacques Chirac announced on Monday that he was calling a snap general election for May 25. However, a planned working meeting between Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl will go ahead as planned in Paris on May 20.
